start_time_note: Each Phase is a round; Unit = heat; each ride of a heat is one Race number with one row per boat (ride count from the scoring sheets' Point columns). Order: official start lists (Tuesday, K1M/K1JW/OC prelims, K1M and K1SM semis, 2-Finals.pdf); other quarter/semifinal heats in the scoring sheets' order (rank) because no start list was published. Times: Tuesday from START-LIST-TUESDAY.pdf (printed on the first heat of each group = heat time; later heats of the group = group block start); Wednesday and Thursday from the organiser's revised schedules on news.php (block starts; the 20 June start-list times are superseded); finals from 2-Finals.pdf (heat times; that PDF says 'Saturday 23rd of June', the finals were Saturday 25 June per news.php and the result printouts); K1SM final ride 3 uses the printed per-boat Startzeit.
